derivation:
apply RingHom.coe_addMonoidHom_injective
  apply (Algebra.GrothendieckAddGroup.lift (M := A) (G := S)).symm.injective; ext a; exact h a
explanation: Mathlib’s `lift` equivalence identifies additive homomorphisms out of the Grothendieck additive group with homomorphisms from `A`. Equality on the generators gives equality of the inverse images under that equivalence, hence equality of the underlying additive homomorphisms and therefore of the ring homomorphisms. The current proof instead invokes `hom_ext`.
